items.title: OpenAI shuts down robotics unit for second time in six years
items.author: TOI TECH DESK
items.description: OpenAI has disbanded its robotics team for the second time in six years, integrating it into other divisions. It believes advancements in general-purpose AI models can manage robotics tasks without a specialized team. items.title: Watch: SpaceX's Starship completes first-ever midair catch on return from orbit

items.description: SpaceX's Starship spacecraft returned from its mission with a successful midair recovery by mechanical arms. However, the Super Heavy booster failed its recovery attempt shortly after launch, resulting in its destruction. The heat shield of the spacecraft performed well, indicating progress toward full reusability.

items.title: Mystery bronze leg in Scottish bog linked to giant Roman emperor statue
items.author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
items.description: Emperor Antoninus Pius, celebrated for his peace-driven rule and military expeditions, may have a newly discovered connection to history. This discovery sheds light on how Rome strategically managed its monuments, and further archaeological investigations could reveal more insights.

items.author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
items.description: The hooded pitohui, distinguished by its vibrant plumage, is the sole avian species known to harbor neurotoxins.
